title: DQM-ML Job Configuration
description: Root configuration for a dqm-ml job. Each field maps to a pipeline stage.

ColumnRename.title: ColumnRename
ColumnRename.description: Mapping from an original column name to a new name.

ColumnsConfig.title: ColumnsConfig
ColumnsConfig.description: Column selection, exclusion, renaming, and prefix/suffix operations.

input.title: Input
input.description: Columns to read (fnmatch patterns supported). None reads all.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix prepended to each column name.

suffix.title: Suffix
suffix.description: Suffix appended to each column name.

CompletenessProcessorConfig.title: CompletenessProcessorConfig
CompletenessProcessorConfig.description: Computes per-column and overall completeness metrics.

device.title: Device
device.description: Compute device: 'auto' picks cuda if available.

DataLoaderConfig.title: DataLoaderConfig
DataLoaderConfig.description: Configuration for a single dataloader (Parquet or CSV).

path.title: Path
path.description: Glob pattern or path to data files.

DataLoadersConfig.title: DataLoadersConfig
DataLoadersConfig.description: Collection of dataloaders for a job.

storage.description: Default storage config inherited by all loaders.

DistanceConfig.title: DistanceConfig
DistanceConfig.description: Distance metric configuration for domain-gap computation.

epsilon.title: Epsilon
epsilon.description: Regularization epsilon for numerical stability of covariance-based metrics (e.g. FID).

feature_weights.title: Feature Weights
feature_weights.description: Per-feature weights for weighted distance computation.

DiversityProcessorConfig.title: DiversityProcessorConfig
DiversityProcessorConfig.description: Computes diversity metrics (Simpson, Gini, Shannon, richness).

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: List of diversity metrics to compute.

DomainGapProcessorConfig.title: DomainGapProcessorConfig
DomainGapProcessorConfig.description: Measures distribution shift between datasets using a distance metric.

default.title: Default
default.description: Default error action when no specific policy is set.

max_failure_rate.title: Max Failure Rate
max_failure_rate.description: Maximum tolerated failure rate before the job aborts (from 0.0 to 1.0).

FeaturesEmbeddingsProcessorConfig.title: FeaturesEmbeddingsProcessorConfig
FeaturesEmbeddingsProcessorConfig.description: Extracts neural-network embedding features from images.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Feature columns to exclude (fnmatch patterns supported).

include.title: Include
include.description: Feature columns to include (fnmatch patterns supported).

FilterConfig.title: FilterConfig
FilterConfig.description: Row-level filter applied during data loading.

values.title: Values
values.description: Value(s) to keep. Rows where column matches are included.

scaling_factor.title: Scaling Factor
scaling_factor.description: Scaling applied to the Gini ratio.

HistogramSummaryConfig.title: HistogramSummaryConfig
HistogramSummaryConfig.description: Histogram settings for embedding summary statistics.

on_decode_failure.title: On Decode Failure
on_decode_failure.description: Action when an image cannot be decoded.

on_transform_error.title: On Transform Error
on_transform_error.description: Action when an image transform fails.

ImageFeaturesProcessorConfig.title: ImageFeaturesProcessorConfig
ImageFeaturesProcessorConfig.description: Extracts low-level image features (luminosity, contrast, blur, entropy).

clip_percentiles.title: Clip Percentiles
clip_percentiles.description: Percentile clipping for extreme pixel values, e.g. (1, 99).

features.title: Features
features.description: List of image features to compute.

laplacian_kernel.title: Laplacian Kernel
laplacian_kernel.description: Laplacian kernel size for blur detection.

luminosity_weights.title: Luminosity Weights
luminosity_weights.description: Luminosity weights for grayscale conversion. Standard name ('bt601', 'bt709', 'bt2020') or [R, G, B] list. Defaults to BT.709 when None.

InterpretationConfig.title: InterpretationConfig
InterpretationConfig.description: Human-readable labels for representativeness and diversity results.

follows_distribution.title: Follows Distribution
follows_distribution.description: Label when data follows the distribution.

min_sample_size.title: Min Sample Size
min_sample_size.description: Minimum samples required for KS test.

sample_size.title: Sample Size
sample_size.description: Number of samples for KS testing.

ModeConfig.title: ModeConfig
ModeConfig.description: Named data-loading mode with an optional output prefix.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix prepended to output column names.

n_layer_feature.title: N Layer Feature
n_layer_feature.description: Layer index or list of layer names for feature extraction.

RepresentativenessProcessorConfig.title: RepresentativenessProcessorConfig
RepresentativenessProcessorConfig.description: Evaluates how representative a dataset is against a reference distribution.

epsilon.title: Epsilon
epsilon.description: Small constant to avoid division by zero.

metrics.title: Metrics
metrics.description: List of representativeness metrics to compute.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Retry mode: 'default' uses exponential backoff, 'standard' uses fixed intervals.

SplitConfig.title: SplitConfig
SplitConfig.description: How to split data into named groups (e.g. train / test).

by.title: By
by.description: Column used to determine the split group.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Split-group values to exclude (fnmatch patterns supported).

values.title: Values
values.description: Explicit list of split-group values to materialise. Auto-discovered if None.

proxy_options.title: Proxy Options
proxy_options.description: Proxy configuration as a dict or URL string.

role_arn.title: Role Arn
role_arn.description: ARN of IAM role to assume.

session_name.title: Session Name
session_name.description: Name for the assumed role session.

tls_ca_file_path.title: Tls Ca File Path
tls_ca_file_path.description: Path to a custom TLS CA bundle.

on_file_not_found.title: On File Not Found
on_file_not_found.description: Action when a data file is not found.

on_missing_column.title: On Missing Column
on_missing_column.description: Action when a required column is missing.

in_place.title: In Place
in_place.description: Overwrite the original column in place.

TransformType.title: TransformType
TransformType.description: Target data type for column transformations.
